findings.title: Double-clicking "Water now" records two waterings
findings.steps: On /beds, double-click "Water now" on a bed (or retry after a slow response).
findings.expected: One watering is recorded. The button is disabled while the request is in flight, and/or the server deduplicates.
findings.actual: The Water now button has no :disabled binding (only its label changes, and only when the past form is closed). The server has no idempotency key or dedupe, so every click inserts a new row.
findings.evidence: Two concurrent POST {"bed_id":2} returned ids 6 and 7 with the same watered_at 2026-11-12 12:40:00. Both appear in GET /api/waterings?bed_id=2. beds.vue: the Water now <button> has @click="waterNow(bed)" and no disabled attribute.

findings.title: Very large bed_id returns 500 Internal Server Error
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (plain text). The integer overflows SQLite's range.
findings.evidence: curl returned 'Internal Server Error 500' for all three requests.

findings.title: Errors on the waterings page and dashboard section offer no retry
findings.where: /waterings and the Recent waterings section of /
findings.steps: Open /waterings or / while the API is down or returns an error, then bring the API back.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that refetches without reloading the page.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown. Neither page has a retry control, and the dashboard doesn't even destructure refresh for waterings. The user has to reload or change the filter.
findings.evidence: waterings.vue / index.vue templates: <AlertMessage v-if="wateringsError"> with no button.

findings.title: Requests have no timeout; Water now and Save watering can stay 'Watering…'/'Saving…' indefinitely
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection but never respond) and click Save watering or Water now.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 seconds with a visible error, and the controls are usable again.
findings.actual: useApiClient/useApiFetch set no timeout, so the request waits forever. The Save button stays disabled with 'Saving…'.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts: $fetch.create has no timeout option, and useFetch is called without one.

findings.title: When the beds list fails to load, the bed filter on /waterings silently shows only 'All beds'
findings.expected: An error saying the beds could not be loaded, with a retry.
findings.actual: bedsResult.error is ignored. The select just offers 'All beds', which looks like there are no beds.
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: const { data: beds } = bedsResult; the error is never rendered.

findings.title: Absurd past dates such as year 0001 are accepted
findings.steps: POST {"bed_id":1,"watered_on":"0001-01-01","litres":1}, or type year 0001 in the date field
findings.expected: The date is refused with a reason (e.g. not before some sensible minimum).
findings.actual: 201 Created. The watering is stored with date 0001-01-01 and appears in the lists.
findings.evidence: The response had id 4 and watered_on 0001-01-01.

findings.title: Boolean true is accepted as litres
findings.evidence: The response had id 5 and litres 1.0.
